# Marking

## Rule

Nearest man when the ball is live in front of us. Jobs on set pieces. Do not follow a runner into a pocket that leaves the penalty spot empty unless that is your job.

Shirt colours have to be on the match stub or this note stays at unit level.

## Cue

Who is yours. If you do not know, you are marking space you have not been assigned. That is a gap.
